cover: Keep WordPress for editing, out of visitors’ way

slides.title: Which problem do you have?
slides.body: If editors like WordPress and the complaints are about slow pages and outages, the editor isn’t the problem.

slides.title: Build pages ahead of time
slides.body: WordPress holds the content. The site is built from it as plain pages, so visitors never touch WordPress.

slides.title: Publishing stays one button
slides.body: At a clinic we worked with, a small plugin waits ninety seconds after a publish, so ten quick saves become one rebuild.

slides.title: A failed build changes nothing
slides.body: If WordPress is down during a build, the build fails and yesterday’s site stays up.

slides.title: Make the build strict
slides.body: Content is checked first. A renamed field stops the build with a clear error before anything goes live.
